description:
[read-only] A/B experiments. Content joins one by carrying the label `experiment:<id>` plus `<compareKey>:<variant>`.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/experiments.)

allBrands.description: true: every brand of the organizations you own or administer, plus your personal brands. Refused (403) for a plain member and for a brand-bound key.

brandId.description: A brand id, or "all" (default: every profile you can see). A brand-bound key is always its own brand.
